notes: Real: the eötvös (E = 10^-9 s^-2) is a non-SI geophysics unit named after Loránd Eötvös (Wikipedia 'Eotvos (unit)', Merriam-Webster). It is rarely mentioned outside gravimetry, so models likely do not hold it.
